children: Hyperliquid Strategies entered into Amendment No. 2 to its ChEF Purchase Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets to refine pricing for stock sales under the facility. The amendment sets the purchase price at 98.5% of VWAP for VWAP or intraday VWAP purchases and 97.0% of VWAP for off-hour VWAP purchases, subject to adjustments. The change is intended to enhance flexibility and clarity for future equity issuances under the program.
: Amendment No. 2 to ChEF Purchase Agreement (equity purchase facility)
: Refine pricing terms to support ongoing equity financing
